about.label: About Us
about.decoDescription: The multi-brand company “Deco Concept” is the exclusive importer of premium class decorative paints in Georgia from leading European countries. The company pays special attention to its customers and purposefully cooperates only with selected brands that lead the world market with the highest quality and innovative design solutions.
about.littleGreeneDescription: Little Greene is an eco-friendly, family-run business cataloguing 300 years of paint and wallpaper. Based in the UK, they create premium paints using traditional methods and the finest ingredients. Their Intelligent paint range offers exceptional durability and a beautiful finish that stands the test of time.
about.royalPaintDescription: Royal Paint by Loggia brings Italian craftsmanship to your walls — premium washable finishes, luminous decorative effects, and a curated palette of 84 designer colours. From velvety super-matte interiors to metallic Mantra textures, every surface becomes a statement.
